description: Defines a template class for managing Windows HANDLE resources with automatic cleanup, including traits for handle validation and closing, as well as tracking and verification utilities.

classes.name: GenericScopedHandle

classes.name: HandleTraits
classes.description: Traits class providing handle validation and closing for Win32 HANDLEs.

classes.name: DummyVerifierTraits

classes.name: VerifierTraits
classes.description: A class for runtime tracking of handle usage.

methods.name: StartTracking

methods.name: OnHandleBeingClosed
